item.title: Osaka in October 2026 Autumn Weather Guide Events
item.description: Osaka in October: Weather, Events & What to Do — The Ultimate Autumn Guide October is when Osaka finally exhales. After months of punishing summer humidity that can leave even the hardiest traveler wilting, the city transforms into something magical — crisp mornings, golden afternoon light, and a culinary scene that shifts into high gear with autumn harvests. If you’re researching Osaka in October weather events what to do, you’ve landed on the best possible month to experience Japan’s second city.
